Thus the proposed case creates persistent field/enrichment rows. The report correctly marks the control blocked pending cleanup, but its expected observation is incomplete and the positive is not a no-write preview.

The procedure is correctly blocked for absent revocation, but the current positive is not a valid success fixture.
